about: 48 hand-written synthetic tickets (30 English, 18 Thai) for Module 17, written on 2026-10-17 in styles the generator never uses: staff radio shorthand, long emails, Thai-English code-switching, negations and distractors. Never trained on. Labels follow Module 16's tickets.json. Not real guests or sites. Five tickets carry a 'note': they are deliberately hard or debatable, so read them before blaming a model.

tickets.text: RM 1418 - guest says aircon dead, room at 30C, kids inside. pls chk
Dear team, we arrived late last night and noticed the bathroom has no towels at all. Could you send a full set at some point this morning? Many thanks, the Lees
Engineering: the basement car park drain is backing up and water is now reaching the main switchboard room door.
The AC is fine, thanks, but the toilet in 2207 has been overflowing for ten minutes and the hallway carpet is soaked.
Quick q — can I pay the rest of my bill in cash at checkout instead of the card on file?
Security patrol: light haze and a smell like an overheated motor coming from the lift machine room, level 26.
No hurry at all, but the fan on the bathroom ceiling in 611 is a bit noisy.
Hello, the shower in 1830 alternates between freezing and scalding every few seconds.
My daughter is allergic to feathers, could you swap the duvet and pillows in 904 for synthetic ones before tonight?
Spa reception: the sauna control box is crackling and gave off a little puff of smoke, we switched it off at the wall.
Earlier I reported a leak under the sink in 1215 — the plumber already fixed it, please close the ticket.
We booked a twin room but got one king bed in 1702. Can someone switch us today?
Kitchen: the extractor hood over the wok station has stopped and the line is filling with heat, service starts in 20 minutes.
There's a strong smell of gas near the staff canteen stove on B1.
tickets.note: gas is not in the written safety definition (smoke, burning, fire, sparks, water near electricity) — a human still labels it safety

tickets.text: Can housekeeping skip our room today? We are sleeping in. 1509
The radiator under the window in 2011 is ice cold and it's snowing outside.
Bathtub in 1311 won't drain at all, standing water with soap scum.
I'd like to know if the hotel can store our luggage after checkout until our evening flight.
The water from the ice machine on floor 8 is leaking straight into the floor socket next to it.
Someone left a room service tray with old food outside 1004 since yesterday, it smells.
pool area: the outdoor shower tap snapped off and is gushing water across the deck
It's freezing in the gym, the AC seems stuck on max and the panel won't respond.
My invoice lists two nights but we stayed three, please correct it before I submit my expenses.
The candles on our anniversary dinner table look lovely, could we get a lighter to relight them? Room 1601
tickets.note: distractor: candles and a lighter, but nothing is wrong

tickets.text: Laundry: dryer number 3 is shooting sparks from the back and tripped the breaker twice.
Could someone show me how to set the thermostat to fan only? It's a bit stuffy but not hot.
Faint drip from the overhead rain shower in 715 even when it's off.
We lost the second key card for 1120, can we get a replacement this afternoon?
Please don't send engineering — the 'burning smell' in 1906 was just my toast, all good now.
tickets.note: cancellation: mentions a burning smell that turned out to be toast

tickets.text: Glass broke in the bathroom of 1012 and there are shards on the floor, my wife cut her foot.
tickets.note: injury from broken glass — debatable queue; housekeeping clears it, urgency is immediate
